status: proposed logical design, implementation and verification pending
basis: OOSEM 17.3.4, five current scenarios, 41 current framework requirements and four enterprise MOEs
scope: Pre-Phase A through adapted C. Analysis, MIL and declared host SIL only. Hardware design representations are inputs, not executing participants.

components.name: Engineering exchange
components.derivation: Connect IF-01--04 and IF-06 to engineering responsibilities. Check incoming meaning before registration and present baseline-linked views.

components.name: Active engineering assistance
components.derivation: Separate rule-based drafting checks from probable semantic findings. Recommend applicable methods, models and lifecycle activities with citations, alternatives, limits and recorded engineer dispositions.
components.sources: NASA 4.2 and Appendix C, 6.8; OOSEM 17.3.4 application components

components.name: Requirements and allocation
components.derivation: Own requirement meaning, proposed spacecraft/EPS/component allocations and bidirectional engineering links. Use sourced design quantities and the engineer-selected derivation method.

components.name: Mission and EPS design
components.derivation: Keep mission assumptions, modeled EPS occurrences, component properties, budgets, sizing and trades on one common basis. Extend the same design into detailed control and interfaces.
components.sources: NASA 3.3--3.6; El Hachimi 2--4; Boan 2--4; Girardello 2--3; Campioli 3--4

components.name: Analysis and host work
components.derivation: Form controlled coupled analysis, applicable RAM and MIL/SIL requests. Coordinate external execution, host coding/builds and independent replay under declared numerical/resource limits.

components.name: Model credibility
components.derivation: Check result numerics and history quality against intended use. Own fidelity, omissions, validity, uncertainty and proposed calibration, with independent assessment kept separate.
components.sources: Casado 2--4 limitations; Zhu pp.7--9 calibration scope; NASA 5.3--5.4

components.name: Phase-product assessment and review
components.derivation: Own EPS verification/validation plans, applicable criterion assessment, critical gaps, review preparation and recording of designated-authority review decisions.

components.name: Configuration and currency
components.derivation: Preserve exact revisions and raw submissions/results. Check current context, invalidate affected outputs, identify reciprocal impacts and retain authorized successor baselines and replay dependencies.
components.sources: NASA 6.2--6.6; Gateau 3.2, 5--6; Campioli 3--4; OOSEM 17.3.4 infrastructure components

allocations.rationale: Requirement semantics and unresolved fields belong with the allocated requirement record.

verification.need: Round-trip quantitative and qualitative records, including unresolved criteria.

allocations.rationale: Active rule and probable semantic checks share explained assistance, separate from technical approval.

verification.need: Compare clean and seeded drafts with an independent expert reference, including valid similar requirements and missed defects.

allocations.rationale: Contextual eligibility and explained alternatives belong to assistance, with model validity supplied by credibility.

verification.need: Use contextual queries whose eligible methods change with inputs, maturity or intended use.

allocations.rationale: Requirements ownership defines link/coverage meaning while configuration preserves exact endpoints.

verification.need: Compare both query directions and coverage with a known relationship set.

allocations.rationale: Cross-domain revision dependencies determine impacts and repeated work.

verification.need: Compare the impact set of coupled load, pointing and interface changes with an expert reference.

allocations.rationale: Only configuration can preserve predecessors and issue an authorized distinct successor.

verification.need: Accept, decline and interrupt changes without erasing the predecessor.

allocations.rationale: Exact product/evidence revisions and decisions define a reconstructible baseline.

verification.need: Reconstruct predecessor and successor manifests and all applicable products.

allocations.rationale: The external receiving responsibility checks meaning before controlled registration.

verification.need: Inject identity, unit, sign and revision mismatches at each active interface.

allocations.rationale: Preservation links every status and raw output to its execution configuration.

verification.need: Trace successful, failed, cancelled and partial outputs to their configurations.

allocations.rationale: Analysis coordination owns replay and comparison, configuration supplies fixed dependencies.

verification.need: Independently replay in the declared host environment and compare under fixed tolerances.

allocations.rationale: Applicability and critical evidence gaps govern phase-product claims.

verification.need: Seed every evidence status and attempt a current claim with a blocking gap.

allocations.rationale: BOM occurrences are the modeled design, distinct from component catalogue definitions.

verification.need: Compare quantities and substitutions with a reference assembly.

allocations.rationale: The same occurrence basis supports consistent dated resource and acquisition estimates.

verification.need: Recalculate after a substitution and preserve unknown prices and availability.

allocations.rationale: Mandatory supported feasibility precedes engineer preference ranking.

verification.need: Use infeasible and closely ranked alternatives with uncertain inputs.

allocations.rationale: EPS variants and extensions remain coherent with design allocations.

verification.need: Configure alternate EPS topologies and retain the distinct allocation and extension revisions.

allocations.rationale: Coupled temporal composition and controlled tool execution realize mission-load/EPS analysis.

verification.need: Use a temporal shortage hidden by an average power budget and check coupling against a reference.

allocations.rationale: Derivation connects spacecraft parents to EPS/component quantities and dispositions.

verification.need: Recalculate an allocation and follow it to the parent and source quantities.

allocations.rationale: Discipline execution profiles expose tool/version mappings and unsupported transfers.

verification.need: Exercise each required discipline profile and incompatible mappings.

allocations.rationale: Controlled MIL stimuli and responses follow the detailed design and assessment criteria.

verification.need: Run declared nominal and fault sequences with a simulated plant and retain failed criteria.

allocations.rationale: Preliminary equations and margins belong with mission assumptions and candidate sizing.

verification.need: Compare sizing and energy balance with independent calculations, including an infeasible eclipse case.

allocations.rationale: Intended use, numerics, omissions and independent evidence bound model-supported conclusions.

verification.need: Attempt conclusions outside validity and with missing independent evidence.

allocations.rationale: Calibration proposals preserve prior values and independent assessment separation.

verification.need: Calibrate from supplied data, retain separate assessment data and decline an update.

allocations.rationale: Every execution plan retains solver/coupling/resource settings, later joined to measured results.

verification.need: Change the time step, solver and resource limits and inspect the run configuration and findings.

allocations.rationale: Corresponding declared host SIL and MIL scenarios support meaningful differences.

verification.need: Use matching MIL/SIL inputs and a seeded code/interface discrepancy.

allocations.rationale: Mission and degraded ConOps revisions supply the common design and analysis basis.

verification.need: Revise a degraded mode and trace its requirement and analysis inputs.

allocations.rationale: RAM applicability follows requirements, ConOps, risks and justified exclusions.

verification.need: Assess applicability with and without repair or redundancy assumptions.

allocations.rationale: Selected RAM transformations follow design failure dependencies without invented rates.

verification.need: Compare transformations and results with a reference and leave missing rates unresolved.

allocations.rationale: Verification requirements and validation expectations need distinct phase-product plans.

verification.need: Distinguish planned activities from results and verification criteria from validation expectations.

allocations.rationale: All assistance dispositions retain human authority and exact suggestion/context identity.

verification.need: Exercise all dispositions and an unauthorized attempt to apply a suggestion.

allocations.rationale: Revision and pending-work currency require immediate invalidation and delayed-response checks.

verification.need: Edit during a delayed response and check that the old response cannot replace current guidance.

allocations.rationale: History comparison needs explicit sample/receipt time bases and known delays.

verification.need: Compare aligned and skewed histories with declared time tolerances.

allocations.rationale: History validity and masks must preserve missing/inactive values rather than zero filling.

verification.need: Inject missing, inactive, invalid and wrong-unit data and compare masks.

allocations.rationale: Detailed interface meaning and ownership belong to the modeled EPS design.

verification.need: Round-trip interface definitions and reject inconsistent endpoint meanings.

allocations.rationale: Engineer-selected integration mappings preserve detailed interface meanings and version gaps.

verification.need: Check a selected profile and expose omitted or incompatible meanings.

allocations.rationale: Control preconditions/effects/recovery are detailed design responsibilities checked in simulation.

verification.need: Exercise nominal, rejected, protection and recovery sequences in simulated conditions.

allocations.rationale: External host coordination is gated by a current specific detailed-design authorization.

verification.need: Attempt an unreleased build and then build the released design, including a toolchain failure.

allocations.rationale: User-facing views derive from controlled records and never define an independent baseline.

verification.need: Compare views with their source baseline and follow represented record links.

allocations.rationale: Scoped entrance/success evidence needs coherent phase-product assessment, not automatic acceptance.

verification.need: Prepare phase-specific packages, including CDR design release and SIR released-product evidence.

allocations.rationale: Activity advice uses maturity, dependencies, findings and review prerequisites.

verification.need: Change maturity and blocking findings and inspect the revised activity proposals.

allocations.rationale: Interactive assistance owns trigger/response/completion status while infrastructure supplies time/context.

verification.need: Measure response delay under the declared workload, including outage and superseded edits.

allocations.rationale: Only designated-authority current decisions change review disposition, separately from preparation.

verification.need: Reject unauthorized or stale-baseline decisions and exercise blocking and conditional findings.

authority.engineers: Approve requirements, model/design choices, suggestion dispositions and exact detailed-design releases.
authority.tools: Execute declared model and host profiles. Execution grants no technical or review approval.
authority.review: Designated authority decides progression against exact baseline and agreed scoped criteria. Preparation is separate.
authority.currency: L08 checks latest context and invalidates changed/pending outputs. L02 records explained assistance and human dispositions.
authority.claims: L06 bounds model-supported predictions. L07 blocks unqualified claims with affected critical evidence gaps.

targets: Current MOP/MOE targets remain TBR at their approved resolution gates. Achieved values are unknown.
